description: Run an unbounded population loop with a dynamically supplied operator.
generation_prompt: Use exec to support a dynamically supplied variation operator in a population loop.
style_note: dynamic operator inside an infinite loop
ground_truth_reason: Ground truth is based on candidate flow and operations, not names. Positive evidence: population: a collection of candidate genomes is initialized and carried through the optimizer; fitness: a computation derives a score or loss from each candidate; selection: candidate-derived parents are chosen by ranking or top-k filtering; mutation: a candidate copy is changed to produce a new candidate; replacement: the active candidate collection is rebuilt or updated with selected parents and offspring. Negative evidence: no child structurally combines two distinct candidate inputs; the evolutionary process has no explicit generation or convergence stop condition. Prompt intent: Use exec to support a dynamically supplied variation operator in a population loop. Policy basis: The existing decision policy treats eval, exec, or dynamic module loading as UNSAFE.
